definitions: Specialised hardware components designed to speed up the processing of artificial intelligence and machine learning workloads.
Integrated circuits or systems optimised for efficient execution of AI algorithms, often found in data centres, edge devices, and autonomous systems.
examples: The company invested heavily in AI accelerators to enhance their data processing capabilities.
New AI accelerators promise significant improvements in real-time image recognition.
Many modern smartphones now incorporate dedicated AI accelerators for on-device machine learning tasks.
